title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E20 — Double Cheeseburger, Hold the Diploma
P.J. threatens to discharge Mark when his student, Earvin, quits school. Geneva can't afford to buy a new bicycle for her daughter, Nicole.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E21 — Groom and Doom
Mark introduces Geneva to a college teacher who asks her to marry him.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E22 — Hangin' with Mrs. Cooper
Mark plots to reunite his parents after his mother, Dorothy (Ja'net DuBois), leaves her husband of 35 years and moves in with Mark. Richard Roundtree guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E1 — Call Me Irresponsible
Mark avoids P.J.'s phone calls and learns, too late, that she had good news. Geneva plays a trick on Vanessa to teach Nicole a lesson.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E2 — My Bodyguard
Mark teaches Tyler how to be a tough guy so that he can protect Nicole against a bully at school. When Tyler's approach doesn't work, Geneva goes up to the school and makes a big scene, scaring the bully away. Vanessa takes care of her boss' prized orchid.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E3 — Between Friends
Mark and a former college buddy embark upon an all-out competition--first with wrestling, then with women. Vanessa finally manages to get a job answering phones at a doctor's office.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E4 — He Said, She Said
Geneva fights with the video store clerk who claims that she never returned the "Mrs. Doubtfire" tape. When Mark breaks up with a woman he was dating from Vanessa's carpool, Vanessa is kicked out.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E5 — Matinee
When he takes Nicole and her friends to the theater, Mark disrupts the movie. Geneva makes 300 penguins for the school's decoration committee.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E6 — Mo' Money
Mark almost gets fired when he buys a vending machine for the school to profit off of the sales. The bus that Vanessa is riding gets hijacked.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E7 — Instant Replay
Mark reluctantly plays basketball with former classmate Reggie Wilson (played by Indiana Pacers superstar guard REGGIE MILLER), now an NBA star. Vanessa connives to go on a date with Reggie.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E4 — Breaking Away
An enthusiastic George takes the family on a fishing trip, but all Webster can think about is the fun he could be having with his buddies.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E5 — The Strike
The unconventional methods of Webster's teacher earn him an A from the students and a pink slip from an outraged PTA.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E6 — George's Brush With Life
After learning that his buddies from school have died, George quits his job and resolves to live life to the hilt.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E7 — The Importance of Being Worthy
Webster and Nicky's excitement over a fund-raiser they organized fizzles when the proceeds are stolen.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E8 — A Hell of a Weekend
A weekend at Wisconsin Dells with parents of Webster's best friend reveals more than Katherine and George want to see, they are nudists.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E7 — Chain, Chain, Chain
A chain letter stirs up trouble and causes havoc with Moesha’s family and friends.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E8 — Job
Moesha gets her first taste of independence when she gets a job and earns her own money.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E9 — Niece
Moesha learns to appreciate Dee and see her in a new light with the help of Dee’s visiting niece Charisse.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E10 — Reunion
Moesha’s father arranges a reunion of Moesha’s childhood playgroup (his motive is to sell Saturns).

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E11 — The Ditch Party
Moesha reports on the annual school “ditch day”, but will not reveal who attended or who her sources are.

S2 E1 — The Handwriting On The Wall
Mary, Rose and Pearl may be sent 'up the river' after they go overboard defending '227' against a graffiti artist who then sues them for assault--and it seems even bleaker when the key to their defense is the testimony of a lone eyewitness--Sandra.

S2 E2 — Fourth Time Around
Mary and Rose help Pearl face the loneliness of old age by escorting her to a single's bar where she meets the man of her dreams--and promptly gets engaged.

S2 E3 — Pillow Talk
When Mary reluctantly agrees to partner with Sandra in the pillow-making business, she finds herself doing all the work--with Sandra reaping all the 'benefits.'.

S2 E4 — Mary Nightingale
Lester turns into a real pain for Mary when he comes home from work early complaining of a stomach ache, but when she sneaks out for a pedicure, Lester is stricken with appendicitis--leaving Sandra to care for him.

While trying to help Holly, Malcolm finds himself juggling three dates at the same time.

title: Malcolm & Eddie

Eddie's new band jeopardizes his work at the garage.
